v04-la-com-die.name: La Comédie
tags: The Place de la Comédie's resident table — renovated historic monument, coloured arcades
v04-la-com-die.why: The Place de la Comédie's resident table — renovated historic monument, coloured arcades. To order: the Plaisir 5-course or Découverte 6-course; menus du Marché change weekly. Chefs Lucie & Guillaume Ferrier. Tue–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 19:00–22:00. Comté, Mont d'Or, Morteau and Jura wines throughout the menu.

v07-la-table-de-perraud.name: La Table de Perraud
tags: Gault & Millau listed — reliable traditional table
v07-la-table-de-perraud.why: Gault & Millau listed — reliable traditional table. To order: pochouse jurassienne (the Jura's freshwater fish stew in white wine and cream), choucroute, andouillette with mustard cream, lamb shoulder. Chef Gabriel Janod. Named for the Jurassien sculptor Jean-Joseph Perraud. The pochouse is the Lyonnais-equivalent dish to test.

v13-maison-du-comt-poligny.name: Maison du Comté — Poligny
tags: Official Comté AOP interpretation centre — visit + tasting
v13-maison-du-comt-poligny.why: Official Comté AOP interpretation centre — visit + tasting. To order: the three-space visit (farm + dairy + cellar) with comparative tasting of three ages of Comté and Marcel Petite's Fort Saint-Antoine cuvée. Note: the Maison du Comté MOVED — new building on the site of the former municipal stadium with traditional Haut-Doubs farm architecture references. The old Avenue de la Résistance address is no longer current. Three themed spaces, tasting at the end.
v13-maison-du-comt-poligny.address: Site of the former municipal stadium, 39800 Poligny

v14-domaine-macle.name: Domaine Macle
tags: The canonical Château-Chalon house — family settled in 1850, 8th generation in 2025
v14-domaine-macle.why: The canonical Château-Chalon house — family settled in 1850, 8th generation in 2025. To order: Château-Chalon (Vin Jaune); Côtes du Jura blanc tradition (Chardonnay ouillé); Crémant. Laurent Macle since 1995 (7th gen); Carmen Macle joined January 2025 (8th gen). 12 ha total: 8 ha Chardonnay (Côtes du Jura) + 4 ha Savagnin (Château-Chalon). Tastings in the family cellar, no theatre. Château-Chalon declassified years: 1974, 1980, 1984, 2001.

v15-domaine-st-phane-tissot.name: Domaine Stéphane Tissot
tags: The biodynamic reference of the Jura — Demeter certified since 2004
v15-domaine-st-phane-tissot.why: The biodynamic reference of the Jura — Demeter certified since 2004. To order: Arbois Trousseau Singulier; Vin Jaune; Vin de Paille; Crémant Indigène; the parcellaire Chardonnays. Bénédicte & Stéphane Tissot, 50 ha, organic 1999 + biodynamic Demeter 2004. Over 30 cuvées on blue and grey marls, limestone and clay — the broadest serious gamme in the Jura. Same village where Pasteur ran his vine experiments.

v16-maison-de-louis-pasteur.name: Maison de Louis Pasteur
tags: Maison des Illustres (2013) — Pasteur's home laboratory, preserved intact
v16-maison-de-louis-pasteur.why: Maison des Illustres (2013) — Pasteur's home laboratory, preserved intact. To order: the 1-hour guided visit; the experimental vineyard in Pupillin (Clos Pasteur) is still maintained. Family moved here 1827, when Pasteur was four. His 1857 Mémoire on lactic fermentation (Académie des Sciences, 30 November) was the foundational fermentation paper — not a doctoral thesis (his doctorate, 1847, was on crystallography). The Arbois lab is among the best-preserved 19th-c. scientific workplaces in France. One hour.

v17-salines-royales-d-arc-et-senans-unes.name: Salines Royales d'Arc-et-Senans (UNESCO)
v17-salines-royales-d-arc-et-senans-unes.why: UNESCO 1982 (Arc-et-Senans) + 2009 extension (Salins-les-Bains) — Claude-Nicolas Ledoux 1775. To order: the visit + the Festival des Jardins (June–October); the semicircular layout of Ledoux's industrial city. Construction 1775; operations 1779–1895; UNESCO 1982; Salins-les-Bains added 29 June 2009. Ledoux's semicircular ideal-city layout, the Director's house at the focal point. Brine arrived via the 21.25-km saumoduc from Salins (wooden pipeline, cast iron from 1782, ~30 % loss to leaks and smugglers).
